how_to_apply: Visit the official website at https://rgssh.delhi.gov.in and navigate to Career & Opportunities.
Access the Google form link provided in the notification or via the direct application link.
Fill the Google form online completely with all required details before the last date.
Submit the Google form on or before 22.10.2026 till 12:00 midnight.
Take a printout of the submitted Google form.
Bring the printout of the Google form along with requisite documents in original and a set of photocopies on the date of interview.
important_instructions: The appointment will be initially for a period of 05 years on the basis of satisfactory work and conduct report from Director, RGSSH being HOD. Candidates must fill the Google form; no candidate will be allowed to appear in the Interview without filling the Google form. 4% seats shall be reserved for DIVYANG (Person with Disability [PwD]) candidates on horizontal basis. Candidates currently working in Govt. Hospitals/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies etc. should bring "No Objection Certificate/prior intimation certificate" and "Experience certificate" from their present employer at the time of Interview. Candidates applying for the post of Medical Officer should be registered with Medical Council of India /State Medical Council. After selection to the post, the registration with DMC mentioning their essential qualification for the selected post shall be mandatory. The post(s) is/are of full time nature and private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited. No TA/DA shall be paid for appearing in the interview. The appointment to the said post will be subject to physical fitness from the competent medical board/ staff physician. Selected candidates will also submit police verification copy within 01 month of joining.

rows.qualification_required: Essential: 1. A recognized Medical Qualification included in the first or second schedule or Part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956 (persons possessing qualifications included in part II of the third schedule should also fulfil the conditions specified in subsection (3) of the section 13 of the Act) 2. Full time PG Diploma in Hospital Administration or equivalent thereto. Desirable: 1. Knowledge of Computers

faq.question: Q1. What is RGSSH Medical Officer (Hospital Administration) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by Rajiv Gandhi Super Speciality Hospital for filling 5 vacancies of Medical Officer (Hospital Administration) on a contractual basis initially for 5 years.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for the Medical Officer (Hospital Administration) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RGSSH Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to fill the online Google form is 22 October 2026 till 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a recognized medical qualification included in the first or second schedule or Part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956 and a full-time PG Diploma in Hospital Administration or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for RGSSH Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years, with relaxations applicable as per Govt. of India/DoPT/Govt of NCT of Delhi rules.
